answer: Sybil floods cheap joins. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 12-epoch stake anchor before grading weight opens; accounts with under 3 peer-attested productive txs stay hollow at weight 0. Cost: early unlock burns 0.8% of locked stake and voids the queue slot. Verification: at epoch close, panels recompute weight from lock-txid plus productive-tx count on-ledger. Failure: if lock breaks early or count drops below 3, weight resets and a whisper flag marks prior grades for re-review.
